text.text:
### Prerequisites

This game practices what we learned in the Schyoty (счёты) text (<htcite0>), where each row has ten beads of value one and the rows count 10^0, 10^1, 10^2 and so on from bottom to top. We recommend reading that text first.

### Representing the integer you choose

Recognizing the importance of practice exercises as a way to reinforce knowledge (<htcite0>), we present a game that uses the same schyoty board: all beads start on the inactive side and you move to the active side as many beads as the digit of each row. The bottom row represents the units, the row above it the tens, and so on (<htcite1>).

#### How the game works

Write a whole number between **0** and **99999999** in the box, using only digits. It must fit in the eight rows, so it cannot have more than eight digits (for example, `7`, `5027` and `99999999` are valid).

Click **Represent** to start the challenge: move beads on each row until the "Value" readout shows your number. As soon as everything matches, you receive the congratulations.

If you cannot do it alone, click **Help me?**: the game clears the board and teaches your number row by row. After the last step you can choose another number or click **Next level**.

#### The eight levels

The badge shows the eight integer levels, from **x** (units) to **xxxxxxxx** (ten millions). At every level you may choose any whole number in the allowed range, with as many digits as you like as long as it fits in the eight rows.

source.text: Costa, M., Cardoso, A. P., Lacerda, C., Lopes, A., & Gomes, C.
